name: skill-creator
description: Create, lint, fix, and extract reusable Python scripts from Agent Skills for Cursor, Codex and Claude Code. Eval-driven development with prompt engineering best practices.

commands.name: SKILL-creator
commands.description: Create, test, and iterate on Agent Skills for Cursor, Codex and Claude Code with eval-driven development

commands.name: SKILL-lint
commands.description: Audit Skill quality, scope, and references; optionally review session evidence against a specified Skill/SOP and fix supported defects.

commands.name: SKILL-pythonGenerator
commands.description: Extract deterministic, repetitive logic from skills into reusable Python CLI scripts

commands.name: SKILL-setup
commands.description: Install, update, configure, or uninstall the skill-creator plugin
